mapper.sql: select supplier_id as supplierId, enterprise_id as enterpriseId, supplier_code as supplierCode, supplier_name as supplierName, contact as contact, phone as phone, email as email, address as address, pay_term_days as payTermDays, lead_days as leadDays, status as status, del_flag as delFlag, remark as remark, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from t_supplier
mapper.select:
where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and del_flag = '0'
and (supplier_name like concat('%', #{supplierName}, '%') or supplier_code like concat('%', #{supplierName}, '%'))
and status = #{status}
order by supplier_id desc
where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and supplier_id = #{supplierId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into t_supplier (enterprise_id, supplier_code, supplier_name, contact, phone, email, address, pay_term_days, lead_days, status, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{supplierCode}, #{supplierName}, #{contact}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{payTermDays}, #{leadDays}, #{status}, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update t_supplier set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and supplier_id = #{supplierId}
update t_supplier set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and supplier_id = #{supplierId} and del_flag = '0'
